captions.text: X AI Reply Assistant · From a post to your reply
Select the Reply button below a post.
The panel reads the context and shows completed suggestions as they arrive.
Once the suggestions are ready, choose one you like.
Select a suggestion to insert it into the reply editor.
Keep editing, then decide for yourself whether to post.
Switch to Humor and generate a different take.
Or choose Professional for a more focused response.
Adjust the number of replies and the reply language.
Generate one English reply and check the content.
Select the suggestion to insert your new reply.
You can stop a request while it is generating.
Select Generate replies again when you want to continue.
Choose a model provider in Settings and enter your own API key.
Set your persona and prompts to match the way you write.
Preview the prompt to check your settings.
X AI Reply Assistant · Make replying easier.
